sloka: सगणं रावणं हत्वा राघवो रघुनन्दनः ।त्वामादाय वरारोहे स्वपुरं प्रतियास्यति ।। ५.३९.४३।।।।
transliteration: sagaṇaṁ rāvaṇaṁ hatvā rāghavo raghunandanaḥ ।tvāmādāya varārohe svapuraṁ pratiyāsyati ।। 5.39.43।।।।

translations.english: "O beautiful lady Raghava, the delight of the Raghu race would kill Ravana and his kins and return with you to his city৷৷
